what: Of several stacked photos, the rest cover the first one in turn as a clip opens from the bottom-left corner — on load, after .2s, at .2s intervals, .8s power2.inOut, with each photo settling from 1.1x to 1x (power1.out). After that one photo is covered every 3s over .8s, and at the end it returns to the start and repeats, while the bottom photo breathes between 1↔1.1x (power1.inOut). Pauses when off-screen

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Stacked photo slots (several, required) — first slot is the base photo
options.[data-fx-part=img]: Image that settles from 1.1 to 1 inside the cell (if none, the whole cell)
options.dur: Length for one slide to cover (sec), default .8
options.hold: Seconds each photo stays on screen when repeating, default 3

note: The panel is position: relative · overflow: hidden, and cells overlap with inset: 0 (fx.css). Clipping opens per cell with --fx-clip(0 → 1)
